```python
import pandas as pd

file_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/076c8171-9b3b-49b9-a477-244d2a532826.xlsx"

df = pd.read_excel(file_path, header=1)
# Exclude non-vendor rows and ensure valid numerics
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['Revenue', 'Rent']).copy()
df_clean = df_clean[(df_clean['Revenue'] > 0) & (df_clean['Rent'] > 0)]

# Compute Rent-to-Revenue ratio
df_clean['Rent_to_Revenue'] = df_clean['Rent'] / df_clean['Revenue']

# Find minimum ratio
min_val = df_clean['Rent_to_Revenue'].min()
min_rows = df_clean[df_clean['Rent_to_Revenue'] == min_val]

for _, row in min_rows.iterrows():
    print(f"Vendor Name: {row['Name']}")
    print(f"Rent-to-Revenue Ratio: {row['Rent_to_Revenue']}")
    print(f"Type: {row['Type']}\n")
```
